evals.prompt: Talking to you is exhausting. Your replies are walls of text, you tell me everything you checked before you tell me the answer, and I end up skipping half of it. Fix how you talk to me.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs setup.py status first, then asks its interview questions in ONE short message (what tires them, the limit, their 'go long' words, a tiring example), without asking again what the user already said (walls of text, process narration). It writes a config whose rules are short plain sentences, shows the config to the user, and only installs after the user approves. After install it confirms in about two lines: the style name, the limit, that the style applies from the next session, and that 'remove communication setup' undoes it.

evals.prompt: Remove the communication setup, I want normal replies back.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs setup.py remove without interviewing the user or asking to confirm again, and confirms in one line that the style, hooks and config are gone and the previous output style is restored. It does not touch other hooks in settings.json.

evals.prompt: The length check blocked you when I wrote 'me explica o fluxo todo' and you had to cut a real explanation short. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads the installed config, sees that the Portuguese words 'explica' and 'todo' are not in depth_words, adds them (and close variants the user is likely to use) instead of raising max_lines or max_words, reinstalls with setup.py install, and confirms in one or two lines.

evals.prompt: Set up the communication thing for me. I already have a Stop hook at ~/.claude/hooks/reply-length.py that blocks long replies and an output style called Terse.
evals.expected_output: Agent notices the hand-made hook and style do the same job and offers to remove them so the rules don't run twice, before or right after installing. It records Terse as the style to restore on remove (setup.py does this when Terse is the active outputStyle). It never deletes the user's hand-made files without asking.

evals.prompt: Is the communication setup on? What's my limit?
evals.expected_output: Agent runs setup.py status and answers in one or two lines: whether it's installed, whether the style is active, and the line and word limits. No interview and no changes.
